8.28. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.path¶

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to paths.

Classes

DivergingPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path)’ if path of type PATH_TYPE contains a facing switch.
EdgeInPath(edgeIndexFunc[, argOrder])
LeftInPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, switch)’ if the left leg of switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is in path of PATH_TYPE.
NextObjectInPath(startUserTypes[, …]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, obj_1, obj_2)’ if obj_2 is after obj_1 in path of type PATH_TYPE.
NextPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path_1, path_2)’ if path_1 ends where path_2 starts and they can be joined to a new path.
NodeEndObject([argOrder])
NodeStartObject([argOrder])
ObjectInPath([facing, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, obj)’ if obj of type INSIDE_TYPE_C is in path of type PATH_TYPE.
PathContainingPath([prefix, suffix, strict, …])
PathIntersectsPath([edgeIntersection, …]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path_1, path_2)’ where path_1 and path_2 of type PATH_TYPE are intersected each other.
RestrictToPaths(predArg[, facing, argOrder])
RightInPath([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, switch)’ if the right leg of switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is in path of PATH_TYPE.
SwitchInPath([diverging, facing, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, switch)’ if switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is inside of path of type PATH_TYPE.
